highlights.title: Withdraw your way
highlights.description: Nimiq Pay now remembers whether you enter withdrawal amounts in crypto or your local currency.
highlights.howTo: When withdrawing, choose crypto or your local currency for the amount. Your choice is saved for next time.

highlights.title: More reliable payments
highlights.description: Payment results appear sooner, and pending transactions recover more reliably after restarting or reconnecting. Fixes also help prevent stuck payments and missing transaction history.

highlights.title: Smoother Mini Apps
highlights.description: Mini Apps now support downloads. Navigation fixes keep controls accessible and prevent the back action from unexpectedly closing Mini Apps.

highlights.title: Find competition entries faster
highlights.description: Search and filters make it easier to browse Mini Apps competition entries.
highlights.howTo: Open the Mini Apps competition and use search or filters to narrow down the entries.

highlights.title: Live chat for everyone
highlights.description: Live support chat is now available to all users, making it easier to get help when you need it.

highlights.title: Cashlinks you can just scan
highlights.description: Scanning a Cashlink now works end to end: the scanner closes on its own once the funds are claimed, and the claim shows up in your history and notifications with the sender's name instead of an unlabeled entry.
highlights.howTo: Tap the scan button on the home screen and point your camera at a Cashlink code. Once it's claimed, the scanner closes automatically and you'll find the payment in your transaction list.

highlights.title: Smoother stablecoin transfers
highlights.description: Fixed the connections used for stablecoin balances and fee estimates, so sending and receiving is more reliable and fees are calculated correctly.

highlights.title: Ready for the network upgrade
highlights.description: Updated to the latest Nimiq network version so your wallet stays fully in sync and compatible after the network upgrade.

highlights.title: Mini Apps competition showcase
highlights.description: Discover the latest competition entries in a new Mini Apps showcase.
highlights.howTo: Open Mini Apps and explore the competition showcase.

highlights.title: Easier wallet recovery
highlights.description: Get helpful word suggestions while entering your recovery phrase, making wallet recovery faster and less error-prone.
highlights.howTo: Choose wallet recovery and start entering your recovery words to see suggestions.

highlights.title: Clearer pending payments
highlights.description: A new hint explains when an incoming NIM payment is still pending, so you know it is on its way.

highlights.title: More useful notifications
highlights.description: Payment notifications now have clearer details and include transaction memos when available.

highlights.title: Better Mini App icons
highlights.description: Mini App icons now load only when needed and are saved for faster access later, improving privacy and performance.

highlights.title: Cleaner in-app browsing
highlights.description: Fixed extra spacing that could appear while viewing content inside Nimiq Pay.

highlights.title: Clearer wording
highlights.description: Updated messages throughout the app to use more consistent, platform-neutral language.

highlights.title: Enter amounts in crypto or fiat
highlights.description: You can now type any amount in either the crypto amount or its fiat value, whichever is easier for you. The app converts it for you automatically.
highlights.howTo: When sending or requesting, tap the amount field and switch between crypto and your local currency.

highlights.title: Secure pending NIM in one tap
highlights.description: Got NIM waiting to be secured? Just tap your pending NIM on the home screen to lock it in right away instead of waiting.
highlights.howTo: On the Home screen, tap your pending NIM balance to secure it.

highlights.title: What's New in the app
highlights.description: See exactly what changed with each update. A friendly summary now appears after you update, with older release notes available anytime.

highlights.title: Smoother Mini Apps
highlights.description: Your most recently used Mini Apps now appear first, each app shows up only once, and opening them is faster and more reliable. Apps without an image now show a clean fallback icon.
highlights.howTo: Find your recent Mini Apps in the row at the bottom of the Home screen.

highlights.title: Reliability & polish
highlights.description: Faster PIN entry, more dependable incoming-payment notifications, a correct app icon on notifications, and "Withdraw All" now clears every last bit of NIM. Biometric login is also disabled when no PIN is set, for better security.

highlights.title: Fixed app stuck on PIN screen
highlights.description: Some users got stuck on the PIN screen after updating. The app now clears out the leftover data that caused this and opens normally.

highlights.title: More reliable startup
highlights.description: If the network has trouble loading when you open the app, Nimiq Pay now still unlocks and lets you in, then catches up on syncing afterward instead of freezing.
